Captured initial launcher state before opening API request audit.

Captured after-open and separate final audit images, then read location.href. Audit filters were not changed.
results.reason: Identifiable audit metrics and chart rendered; no sign-in or application error page appeared. Rolling audit URL timestamps update automatically; browserUrl was read at the final audit state.

results.criterion: After viewing API Request Audit, using browser Back returns to the launcher and GIS remains available.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the launcher and captured its visible initial state before opening the audit module.
Clicked Open API request audit; waited for Requests and errors over time and captured the audit state before Back.
Used browser Back; waited for the launcher and verified Open GIS remained available.
Captured after-Back and separate final launcher images; read location.href and verified the exact launcher URL.
results.reason: Browser Back returned to the exact launcher URL with the GIS card and Open control visible.

results.criterion: From the returned launcher, selecting Open for GIS displays the settled map and map controls rather than a sign-in or application error page.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the launcher; waited for visible content and captured initial state.
Opened API request audit; verified the visible chart and captured audit state before Back.
Used browser Back; verified the exact launcher URL and captured returned launcher before opening GIS.
Clicked Open GIS; waited for map settling, verified rendered streets/labels and map controls, then captured after-open and separate final GIS images and read location.href.
Returned to the exact launcher URL after final evidence; captured cleanup separately. No layers, settings, filters, selections or application data were changed.
results.reason: Settled GIS basemap and controls rendered at /gis. A pre-existing ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas layer/panel displayed 'Unable to load coverage gap candidate areas.' This ancillary layer data error did not prevent the map/navigation assertion; no layer was added or changed. Existing GIS state was preserved and cleanup ended on launcher.

conciseReport: All four navigation criteria passed with independent launcher starts, criterion-owned PNG evidence and browser-derived final URLs. API Request Audit showed metrics/chart; Back returned to the launcher; GIS displayed a settled map and controls. Existing coverage-gap layer data showed a load error, recorded as an ancillary observation. No application data or saved settings were changed; finished on launcher.
